build_furthest_point_sample: build a python module to sample N furthest points from a point cloud tensor using furthest_point_sample
build_furthest_point_sample_with_dist: build a python module to sample N furthest points from a distance matrix tensor using furthest_point_sample_with_dist
review_FurthestPointSampling: review the FurthestPointSampling class that performs iterative furthest point sampling on 3D point coordinates
review_FurthestPointSamplingWithDist: review the FurthestPointSamplingWithDist class that performs iterative furthest point sampling on a precomputed distance matrix
test_furthest_point_sample: test the furthest_point_sample function by passing a batch of 3D point clouds and checking returned indices
